issues.problem: Intro said all patterns are tails on the te-form or nai-form, but ましょう / ませんか / ましょうか attach to the masu-stem.
issues.action: Changed to 'Most of these patterns ...; ましょう / ませんか attach to the masu-stem.'

issues.problem: pt-nakereba rule 'Nai-form minus い + ... or just と' would build *行かなと; ないと keeps the い.
issues.action: Rewrote rule: nai-form minus い + ければならない (or + くてはいけない), or in speech nai-form + と.

issues.problem: pt-mashou explain claimed all three forms involve the speaker; ませんか also makes suggestions where the listener acts alone (読んでみませんか), and the guide's own contrast 手伝いませんか has the listener acting.
issues.action: Removed the claim; described ませんか as invitation or suggestion with the example 読んでみませんか.
